lines.speaker: Elder Fern
lines.text: Ah, there you are, little sprout! The Rootway inside the Great Hollow Oak is humming again.

lines.speaker: Elder Fern
lines.text: The river portal is awake. Mother Gloop has been sloshing about over there. Off you hop!

lines.speaker: Elder Fern
lines.text: Remember: press jump in the air to jump again. Three times, if you're brave.

lines.speaker: Elder Fern
lines.text: You popped Mother Gloop? The whole village heard the splat!

lines.speaker: Elder Fern
lines.text: Bring me any Glimmer Seeds you find. Mossbrook could use some colour.

lines.speaker: Elder Fern
lines.text: Every Glimmer Seed you bring home blooms into something lovely. Look at the flower beds!

lines.speaker: Elder Fern
lines.text: Mind the river. Water is the only blue that bites.
